name: The Swamp Talker
summary: Orders bound for the Blasted Lands vanish in a murloc ambush. Bengor tells you what happened before he loses consciousness.

sections.title: Bengor's Broken Account
sections.body: Bengor says the dispatch commander gave out the orders. His group was bound for the Blasted Lands when many murlocs fell upon them. One of them, Swamp Talker, seized the orders from Bengor as a spear struck his skull. Before he passes out, Bengor speaks of a cave to the east. Recover the orders and take them to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

sections.title: The Fallen Hero's Reckoning
sections.body: The Fallen Hero of the Horde finds the cost worse than imagined. Nineteen of the Hero's men might have been spared agony if the Hero had not acted so irrationally. Powerless to help them, the Hero asks you to aid those men.

faq.answer: During the ambush, a murloc named Swamp Talker took the orders from Bengor's hands.

faq.q: Where did the Swamp Talker go?
faq.answer: As Bengor fades, he speaks of a cave to the east.

faq.q: Where were Bengor and his unit heading?
faq.answer: Bengor and his unit were carrying orders from the dispatch commander to the Blasted Lands when murlocs ambushed them.

faq.q: To whom should the orders be returned?
aliases: where do i turn in the orders
faq.answer: Take the orders to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
